submission.justification: Absorber-F1 gave the best resolution of the three. In the scan the 4 mm plate was best at 3.22%, against 3.67% at 2 mm, 3.42% at 6 mm and 3.71% at 8 mm. At 2 mm, F2 gave 4.52% and F3 gave 5.84%. The 2025 summary at 5 mm ranks them the same way (3.2%, 3.9%, 5.1%). WARNING: the hard residual-dose requirement (≤20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week) could not be checked. None of the project documents or simulation tools provide activation or dose data for any candidate. This recommendation is conditional on a dose/activation calculation for F1, which must be done before the choice is final. If F1 fails that check, the fallback would be the next-best option that passes. I did not simulate F2 or F3 beyond 2 mm, so I did not map their optimum thicknesses.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F1 at 4 mm gives 3.219%, the best of the simulated points. F2 and F3 were only simulated at 2 mm (4.52% and 5.84%), and the 2025 5 mm results rank them the same way.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after 1 week cooldown ≤ 20 uSv/h (hard)
requirements.evidence: No dose or activation data exist in any document or simulation tool. This must be verified before the choice is final.

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three listed materials
